cx2_truthful.basis: The custodian saw Quell enter alone with a wet umbrella; the sensor notice explains false double counts from umbrellas. Single-person elevator trips and floor-3 logs support her route and roughly fifteen-minute visit. Policy permits retrieving personal items after hours. The records resolve the alert without establishing an accompanying entrant or concealed involvement.

cx2_deceptive.basis: Quell acknowledges admitting Evan on her swipe but leaves their movements unaddressed in A3. Her badge log establishes records-floor access; paired two-person elevator trips support their visit together. Shared-swipe admission was prohibited, and no after-hours visitor was registered. The sensor defect does not explain the independent elevator counts and witness sighting.

cx3.basis: The two-person alert is inconclusive because the sensor had documented false double counts. No examined record establishes that Mara admitted anyone. A3 does not locate Evan during her visit, and A4 does not explain her exit. The main gaps remain unresolved, but these omissions alone do not establish concealment.
